description: Evaluation of Drainage for Liquefaction Remediation is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Ellen Rathje, University of Texas at Austin (utexas.edu). This project looked at the response of liquefiable sand deposits with and without prefabricated drains installed. The project involved centrifuge testing, as well as field testing in South Carolina. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/DS2J08P. Keywords: Liquefaction, Drains, Lateral Spreading. Published 2017-06-05. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the DesignSafe listing (publication licences offered are CC BY 4.0, ODC-By, CC0 and GPL; project page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
